items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Alvin, that's Alvin's brother I used to work with.

ctx.x: And when was Eddie played with Kelly? About in the 20's?

Oh, it was about the 20's. Right after Kelly died, he laid him out on the sand between Trayvon and Robinson in the middle on that side of the bank. He had a big few of them, Southern Stan. He did? That's right. He must have been very popular. He was. One of the best, he moved a short trumpet like that. He had a short trumpet? Yeah, he had a short one. I had one too, I got rid of it. You know the little small arm like that? I got rid of it. Did he play it too? No, he didn't play it, but he had it. And he's…
George McCubbin they call him, he's dead. Oh, that's Alvin's brother? Yeah, that's Alvin's brother.
